title: Accessors, Mutators, Casts aur Enums
objectives: Computed attribute banana aur `$appends` se JSON mein dikhana

sections.heading: Accessor aur mutator
sections.body: **Accessor** model se value padhte waqt use badal deta hai. **Mutator** database mein save karte waqt. Laravel mein dono ek `Attribute` method mein likhte hain.
explain: Method ka naam column ke naam jaisa (camelCase), `protected` aur return type `Attribute`.
Sirf `get:` ya sirf `set:` bhi de sakte ho.

sections.heading: Computed attribute aur $appends
sections.body: Aisi value jo database mein hai hi nahi, par model par chahiye:

code.code:
$product->price_with_gst;       // snake_case mein padho
$product->toArray();            // price_with_gst bhi aayega, cost_price nahi

explain: `$hidden` – JSON/array mein kuch columns chhupao (jaise password, cost_price).

sections.heading: Casts: column ka type badalna
sections.body: Database se aksar sab strings aate hain. Cast se Eloquent value ko sahi PHP type mein badal deta hai.

code.code:
$product->is_active;                 // true / false
$product->launch_date->format('d M Y'); // Carbon date object
$product->meta['color'] = 'black';   // JSON column array ki tarah
$product->save();

explain: `'password' => 'hashed'` password ko save karte waqt hash kar deta hai.
`casts()` method Laravel 11 se hai. Purana `protected $casts = [...]` bhi chalta hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Enum cast
sections.body: Product ka status (draft ya published) strings mein likhne se typo ka khatra rehta hai. PHP Enum aur cast se safe aur readable ban jaata hai.

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Enums;

enum ProductStatus: string
{
    case Draft = 'draft';
    case Published = 'published';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Draft => 'Draft',
            self::Published => 'Live',
        };
    }
}

explain: Migration mein `status` ek string column hota hai (`$table->string('status')->default('draft')`).
Cast ki wajah se `$product->status` string nahi, Enum object milta hai.
Query mein bhi Enum seedha de sakte ho.

versionDiff.heading: Casts: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Accessors, mutators aur casts teeno versions mein kaam karte hain. Casts define karne ka tareeka 11 se badla.

items.11: `casts()` method (naya tareeka) aur `$casts` property dono chalte hain. `Attribute::make()` standard hai.
items.13: Same. Model config ke liye naye attributes (`#[Fillable]`, `#[Hidden]`) hain, par casts ke liye `casts()` method hi hai (maine koi alag cast attribute docs mein confirm nahi kiya).

errors.error: Value "xyz" is not a valid backing value for enum ProductStatus
errors.cause: Database mein ya input mein aisi value hai jo Enum ke cases mein nahi.
errors.fix: Sahi value daalo, ya Enum mein case jodo.

errors.error: Accessor ka computed field JSON/array mein nahi aa raha
Cast ke baad bhi value string aa rahi hai
errors.cause: `casts()` mein column ka naam galat hai ya cache purani hai.
errors.fix: Naam check karo aur `php artisan optimize:clear` chalao.

debug.body: Cast ke baad type dekhne ke liye Tinker mein `var_dump` karo.

quiz.why: Accessor model se value padhte waqt chalta hai, mutator save karte waqt.

options: Computed attribute ko JSON/array mein shaamil karta hai
quiz.why: `$appends` accessors ko `toArray()`/JSON mein include karta hai.

quiz.q: Enum ko model mein kaise use karte hain?
options: Migration mein enum type se hi
quiz.why: Cast se `$product->status` Enum object ban jaata hai.

interview.a: Accessor value padhte waqt badalta hai, mutator save karte waqt. Dono `Attribute::make(get:, set:)` se banate hain.
Column ki value ko sahi PHP type (bool, array, date, Enum) mein automatically badalne ka tareeka.
`$hidden` JSON/array se columns chhupata hai. `$appends` computed attributes jodta hai.
Typos se bachav, readable code aur type safety.
Dono kaam karte hain. `casts()` method Laravel 11 se naya tareeka hai jisme PHP code (jaise Enum class) saaf likhta hai.

summary: `$appends` computed attributes ko JSON mein jodta hai, `$hidden` chhupata hai.
`casts()` se column ko bool, date, array, Enum jaise types milte hain.
Enum cast typos se bachata hai.
Casts ke liye `casts()` method, Laravel 13 mein bhi.
